selection_rule: From official FSD50K metadata, retain clips with CC0 or CC BY audio and exactly one target class; exclude all 100 inspection IDs; take the first 80 numeric IDs per class, assigning 64 to train and 16 to validation.
split_boundary: Clip-disjoint. FSD50K has no speaker identity; uploader is not treated as speaker.
audio_fetch: Individual pinned transport URLs only; no full audio archive was downloaded.
